title: OutcomeBound instruction audit report v2
description: What `outcomebound instructions check --json` prints (docs/specs/instructions/design.md). `result` is the top-level verdict. Every finding is the engine's reading of an untrusted file: a fact, the prompt standard's rule it answers to with that rule's severity, and a next step for a person or an agent to take, never an applied edit and never a score.

result.description: FAIL on any gate FAIL; else UNVERIFIED on any unverified fact or review hit; else PASS. Under --strict an UNVERIFIED result is FAIL.

target.description: The target as the caller named it.

selected_by.description: Where the harnesses came from: --harness; the target's manifest, with `+present` where rows whose files the target holds were added to it; or every row of adapters/harnesses.json.

listed_by.description: How the target's files were found: `git`, what Git tracks or does not ignore; `walk`, every file under a target Git cannot list or ignores. Each path a harness row names exactly is looked up either way.

listing.description: The same, in a sentence, with why the files were walked.

counts.description: Per check family, how many results read each verdict.

findings.description: Every result, security first; one about a whole file or none carries line 0.

path.description: Target-relative path, `.` for the target as a whole, or `adapters/harnesses.json` for a harness's loading facts.

line.description: 1-based line of the fact, or 0 where it concerns the whole file.

fact.description: What was observed, reproducibly; quoted text has every character outside printable ASCII escaped.

rule.description: The rule of docs/prompt-standard.md the check answers to.

severity.description: The prompt standard's severity entry for the rule.

next.description: The next step, for a person or an agent to take; never taken by the command.

decides.description: false for a finding that is reported and does not change the result: OutcomeBound's own finish-check entry where AGENTS.md shows the Done commands it runs, a file loaded from a folder above the target, an unverified row the target does not use, or a review hit a person ruled safe.

id.description: A review hit's ruling id, pinned to its check, path and fact and to its file's bytes; empty where no ruling applies.

ruled.description: The day a person ruled this review hit safe, read from their own rulings file (~/.outcomebound/rulings.json); empty if none.

steps.description: Steps for the person to run sandboxed, without network or credentials; the command runs none of them.
